title: UI Feed Item Projection
description: A single item in the UI event feed. Published by om-control-plane on ui.feed.recent and ui.feed.important. This is a bounded, curated projection — NOT a raw event firehose. The control plane selects which events are feed-worthy and normalizes them into this shape.

id.description: Unique feed item ID (typically the source event ID).

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the underlying event.

title.description: Short headline for the feed item.

source.description: Actor ID that originated the underlying event.

entity_id.description: Related entity ID if applicable (for deep-linking to asset detail).

severity.description: Importance level for filtering and highlighting.

subject.description: The original NATS subject of the underlying event (for traceability).

actions.description: Optional quick actions available from the feed item.
